positive_snippets:
Stayed at this hotel in August on a official trip. Here're my impressions about the place:
1. Room: Pretty decent room. Room size was adequate with nicely done room and decor. The table could be better (its too narrow) and there was no chair in the room, instead there were some stools with wheels. Not workable. The Tata Sky connection had to be refreshed every time it was switched off, so it was a bit of a hassle. The washroom was nice and the pressure in the shower was one of the best I have found. So all in all, it was a decent room, with some minor irritants
2. Service: The staff was very courteous and very very polite. That really took the experience to another level.
3. Amenities: there is a fully functional restaurant but I never tried it. The breakfast buffet menu seemed limited but i did not try the food. This despite being a very large property, there is no fitness centre, which is a big negative. Wi-fi is pretty good.
4. Location: right on the highway, the location was pretty okay.
5. Overall: The property is pretty nicely done and its a grand place. Overall feel is quite nice. Except for the small things, this is a pretty decent option for staying in Navsari.
